# Torn Jin Scripthub

One userscript for [Torn City](https://www.torn.com) that bundles many small tools ("modules").
Install it once, then switch each module **on or off** from the hub – no more juggling a dozen
separate userscripts. Everything runs on the official **Torn API** and shows its results right
in the browser; no Google Sheets or external services.

**[⬇ Install Torn Jin Scripthub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JintheGreat-4k/torn-jin-scripthub/main/dist/torn-jin-scripthub.user.js)**

New modules are added over time – updating the hub delivers them automatically (new modules
start in their *Default* state, which you can change at any time).

## Quick start

1. Install a userscript manager: [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/) or
   [Violentmonkey](https://violentmonkey.github.io/). [Torn PDA](https://github.com/Manuito83/torn-pda) works too.
2. Click **Install Torn Jin Scripthub** above – your manager opens its install dialog.
3. Open torn.com. The hub opens by itself on first start: paste your API key and press **Save**.
4. Flip the switches of the modules you want. Changes apply instantly in every open Torn tab.

Later you open the hub from the **🧩 Hub** tab on the left edge of the screen (or via the
Tampermonkey menu → *Open Torn Jin Scripthub*). Modules that have a window add their own tab
right below it (e.g. **📈 Stocks**).

Updates are picked up automatically through `@updateURL`.

## API key & safety

- Create a key under **Torn → Settings → API Keys**. A **Limited Access** key covers every module;
  the table above lists the minimum level each module needs.
- One key is shared by all modules. It is stored only in your browser (userscript storage) and is
  only ever sent to `api.torn.com`. In Torn PDA the key is filled in automatically.
- The modules only **read** data and never perform in-game actions, in line with the
  [Torn API rules](https://www.torn.com/api.html).
- Each request carries a `comment=` (e.g. `StockROI`, `ChainAlarm`) so you can attribute it in
  your API log.

## Migrating from the standalone scripts

Earlier versions of *Torn Stock ROI* and *Torn Chain-Alarm* were separate userscripts. Both are now
modules of the hub:

1. Install the hub.
2. Remove the old **Torn Stock ROI (API)** and **Torn Chain-Alarm** scripts in your userscript manager.
3. Enter your API key in the hub once and enable the modules you used.

Settings from the old scripts are not carried over (userscript managers keep each script's
storage separate). If an old Chain-Alarm copy is still installed, the module detects it and
shows a warning instead of ringing twice.

## Repository layout

```
dist/torn-jin-scripthub.user.js   the installable userscript (generated – do not edit)
src/hub/                          hub core: settings, module switches, API helper, UI
src/modules/<id>/                 one folder per module (module.json + source files)
src/modules/_template/            starting point for a new module
docs/                             architecture, contributor guide, one page per module
tools/build.mjs                   bundles src/ into dist/ and updates the table above
tests/                            unit tests (node --test)
```

## Development

Requires Node.js 18+ (no npm dependencies).

```bash
npm run build   # bundle src/ -> dist/ and refresh the module table in this README
npm test        # unit tests
npm run check   # fails if dist/ or README.md are out of date (runs in CI)
```

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) – how the hub, modules and the build fit together
- [docs/adding-a-module.md](docs/adding-a-module.md) – step-by-step guide for new modules
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) – hub releases

## Issues & ideas

Please open an [issue](https://github.com/JintheGreat-4k/torn-jin-scripthub/issues). For bugs,
include the module name, its version (shown in the hub) and any error message it displays.
